Original Native10+7 load exactly 28 full bodies and do not execute Realm or LSS.
BOMB13 comparison loads those 28 unchanged bodies plus actual LSS and Realm (30 full bodies).
Instances, signals, CFrame, clock and AABB queries are Native fixtures; this is not Roblox Studio, real network or live physics.
Terrain case substitutes a Terrain instance for an intersected fixture wall; it does not test Roblox voxel physics.
The original12 case bytes are retained, but their superseded fractional-clock OUTSIDE_RADIUS branch is never used.
Only the separately frozen exact-clock OUTSIDE_RADIUS case is accepted; game cooldown remains 8 seconds.
Original Core34 source/composer/tests/README and existing workflow job remain unchanged. Its historical31 input can expire independently.
PASS for this added job does not imply the old Core34 job or the whole hosted workflow passed.
